correctness.rationale: For once-subdivided m-arm stars, dim L=4m+1+m(m+1)/2 and W=center has m(m+1)/2 generators. Every b_i column of D sits in the hub row; with m other a_i columns, rank D≤m+1. The alternating block rank is bounded by Vdim(=2m+1)+rankD≤3m+2, and evenness sharpens to 2(m+1)+2⌊m/2⌋. The explicit functional with all t_i=1, nonzero z_ij on disjoint pairs, and selected b_i coefficients makes rankD=m+1; on ker D^T the C-block is ⌊m/2⌋ nondegenerate alternating two-planes, attaining the bound over every field. Subtracting from dimL gives index m(m+1)/2+2⌈m/2⌉−1. Reviewed check_index.py which independently builds graph incidence and path brackets; its enumerations are finite evidence, not the proof.
